name: Bare Witness
source:
When a young man heads off to art school after a major upheaval in his life, he has no idea that someone from his past is waiting there to potentially cause further disaster.

[From [url=https://alterworlds.itch.io/barewitness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经历人生剧变后，一位年轻男子前往艺术学校求学，却不知道，过去的某个人正在那里等着他，可能引发更大的灾难。

[摘自[url=https://alterworlds.itch.io/barewitness]Itch.io[/url]]
